pack.name: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 architecture baseline
pack.description: Architecture checks mapped to selected NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 controls. Not an authorization package or attestation.

rules.title: Account management boundaries
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify account ownership, lifecycle boundaries, and the systems that enforce joiner, mover, and leaver changes.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document identity authority, provisioning ownership, and deprovisioning evidence for each trust boundary.

rules.title: Least privilege authorization
rules.description: Architecture evidence should show that permissions are assigned to the smallest role and scope that supports the intended operation.
rules.remediationGuidance: Reduce broad role assignments, document privileged paths, and require review for elevation.

rules.title: Audit record generation
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify which security-relevant actions produce audit records and where those records are retained.
rules.remediationGuidance: Map identity, data, and administrative actions to an append-only collection and review path.

rules.title: Audit record protection
rules.description: Architecture evidence should show that audit records are protected from unauthorized change, deletion, and access.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use separate ownership, retention controls, and restricted write paths for audit storage.

rules.title: Configuration change control
rules.description: Architecture evidence should connect production configuration changes to an approved change process and an accountable owner.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record change authority, deployment path, rollback expectations, and the evidence retained after release.

rules.title: Boundary protection
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify trust boundaries and the controls that limit traffic crossing each boundary.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document ingress, egress, private connectivity, and inspection points for each sensitive boundary.

rules.title: Cryptographic protection
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify where sensitive data is protected in transit and at rest and who controls the keys.
rules.remediationGuidance: Map encryption requirements to data stores, service links, key ownership, rotation, and recovery.

rules.title: Vulnerability monitoring
rules.description: Architecture evidence should show how vulnerabilities are identified, prioritized, assigned, and tracked to closure.
rules.remediationGuidance: Connect vulnerability signals to an owner, severity decision, remediation path, and verification evidence.

rules.title: Incident response preparation
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify the people, telemetry, dependencies, and recovery paths needed to respond to an incident.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document response ownership, escalation routes, evidence access, and service recovery dependencies.

rules.title: Contingency planning dependencies
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify recovery objectives, critical dependencies, and the locations of recoverable data.
rules.remediationGuidance: Map critical services to backup, replication, recovery order, and tested restoration evidence.

rules.title: Supply-chain component accountability
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify important suppliers, managed services, and component ownership at system boundaries.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record supplier responsibility, service dependencies, contract controls, and replacement or exit assumptions.

rules.title: Security and privacy architecture
rules.description: Architecture evidence should make security and privacy requirements traceable to components, data flows, and accountable decisions.
rules.remediationGuidance: Maintain a requirements-to-architecture trace and record residual risks that remain after design review.
